key.name: dock-radius
key.description: The corners of the dock of Dash to Dock: 'round' is as round as the floating top bar, a number is a radius in pixels, and 'dock' keeps the radius Dash to Dock draws.

key.name: show-apps-icon
key.description: The icon of the Show Applications button of the dock. Empty is the icon of the flavor in use that comes with the extension, 'gnome' keeps the icon GNOME draws, and an .svg or .png file is that file, with {flavor} in its name standing for the flavor in use.
